question: Should Caralluma fimbriata be recommended for: appetite suppression / weight loss in obesity?

records.notes: A meta-analysis pooling 7 clinical trials of Caralluma fimbriata for weight management found no significant effect on body weight, BMI, or appetite parameters (only minor waist-circumference changes), and the authors conclude it is unlikely to be recommendable as a weight-loss or appetite-suppression supplement.
records.source_title: Effects of Caralluma fimbriata extract on appetite, obesity and metabolic parameters: a systematic review and meta-analysis
records.study_design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs
records.target_indication: appetite suppression / weight loss in obesity
records.primary_outcome: appetite suppression / weight loss in obesity
